title: GCompris
pre: $m='C:\gc.msi'; Invoke-WebRequest -UserAgent 'Mozilla/5.0' -Uri https://download.kde.org/stable/gcompris/qt/windows/gcompris-qt-26.2-win64-gcc.msi -OutFile $m; Start-Process msiexec -ArgumentList '/i',$m,'/qn' -Wait; Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter *.exe 'C:\Program Files\GCompris*','C:\Program Files (x86)\GCompris*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | % FullName
